answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake bond before earning: 50 POA held for 30 days, verified on-chain, slashed if fraud or duplication is proven. A second identity needs a second 50 POA, ten need 500 POA idle for a month, so a sybil farm's capital cost rises linearly while reward per identity stays flat. Like a lagoon admitting boats only through one tolled channel, or a meadow where every plot needs its own fence, scarcity is enforced: a prism splitting one identity into many copies still pays full bond per copy, so cloning multiplies cost, not profit.
